ai_summary: Ador Welding Limited reported a strong Q1 FY19 performance, achieving 17.8% revenue growth and a significant turnaround from a net loss to a profit of INR 4.13 Cr, primarily driven by robust growth in its core welding business. However, the Project Engineering Business (PEB) segment remains a material concern, continuing to operate at a loss of INR 0.83 Cr. A key red flag is the substantial increase in working capital days from 39 to 67, indicating reduced efficiency in capital utilization and potential strain on cash flow.
